data.one_liner: CleverTap Flutter SDK for mobile customer engagement, analytics, and retention solutions.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to integrate CleverTap analytics, user engagement, push notifications, and in-app messaging features into Flutter applications across Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
use_when: You need to integrate CleverTap analytics and customer engagement features into your mobile app
You want to manage push notifications and in-app campaigns via CleverTap
avoid_when: You are looking for a generic logging or non-CleverTap analytics solution
You do not use CleverTap as your backend customer engagement platform
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms
Integrates natively with CleverTap Android, iOS, and Web SDKs
Provides ready-to-use APIs for push notifications, Native Display, and user analytics
weaknesses: Requires manual native platform setup steps for Android and iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires adding platform-specific configuration and native dependencies for Android and iOS as outlined in the technical documentation.

alternatives.name: mixpanel_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Mixpanel if you prefer Mixpanel's product analytics platform over CleverTap.

alternatives.name: sentry_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Sentry if your primary goal is error tracking and crash reporting rather than user engagement.
